input.prompt: Premium dark infographic background for a gratitude and human acknowledgment brand. Pure black to near-black (#000000 to #0d0d0d) vertical canvas. Four horizontal zones stacked top to bottom, each with a soft radial glow orb bleeding in from the left edge, transitioning color per zone: top zone pink glow (#FE3184), second zone coral glow (#FF6B35), third zone warm orange glow (#ec7211), fourth zone blended pink-orange glow. Thin subtle gradient divider lines separating each zone, faint grid texture at 3 percent opacity in the background. Generous empty negative space on the right side of each zone for large numeral text to be added later. A soft ambient glow arch at the very top of the canvas behind where a title will sit. Bottom right corner kept clear and uncluttered. Cinematic, luminous, high end tech and nonprofit hybrid aesthetic, no text, no numbers, no letters anywhere in the image.

content.text:
![Gratitude 4:5 image](/api/resources/8ddcdb96-326b-494c-90ee-1b34cc9a5155/download?inline=1)

Here's the layout spec to set on top of that background:

**Canvas:** 1080x1350 (4:5, feed and partner-share ready)

**Title (top zone, Anton, uppercase, white, 48px, centered, tracking tight):**
OUR IMPACT TO DATE

**Subhead (Inter, 16px, white 60% opacity, centered, below title):**
Gratitude, delivered.

**Four stat rows (one per glow zone), each formatted:**
- Value: Anton, uppercase, 96px, white, gradient text (pink to orange)
- Label: Inter, 14px, uppercase, tracking 0.1em, white 50% opacity, directly below value

| Row | Value | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [NEEDS INPUT: total acts delivered] | Acts Delivered |
| 2 | [NEEDS INPUT: number of funders] | Funders |
| 3 | [NEEDS INPUT: number of nonprofit partners] | Partners |
| 4 | [NEEDS INPUT: number of cities] | Cities |

**Footer (Inter, 12px, white 40% opacity, centered, above logo safe zone):**
As of [NEEDS INPUT: date]. gratitude.com

Send me the four numbers and the as-of date and I'll lock the final copy. One note: these figures need to be verified counts, not estimates, since we never publish unconfirmed traction numbers.
